groups.title_zh: 小野药品与 Aitia 合作，以因果 AI 探索神经疾病靶点
groups.summary: 小野药品于9月2日公布与 Aitia 的神经疾病药物发现合作。双方将利用临床及组学数据构建的数字孪生，寻找新治疗靶点和生物标志物。小野获得的是针对所发现靶点的候选药物全球独家研发与商业化权利的选择权，并非已经完成全部授权或推出药物。公告未披露交易金额，也未提供候选药物的临床有效性结果。
groups.summary_en: Ono announced a neuroscience drug-discovery collaboration with Aitia on September 2. Causal-AI digital twins built from clinical and omics data will support target and biomarker discovery. Ono receives an option for exclusive worldwide development and commercialization rights to candidates against identified targets. This is not a completed exercise of those rights or a drug launch. Financial terms and clinical efficacy results were not disclosed.
groups.scope_zh: 以小野官方公告核对合作事实；聚合报道不视为已阅读全文。
groups.scope_en: Collaboration facts checked against Ono's announcement; indexed reports were not treated as fully reviewed articles.

Link Medical Products is the development and sales partner for Australia and New Zealand. The announcement establishes Australian approval, not simultaneous New Zealand approval or a new clinical trial readout.

groups.title_zh: Abcam 扩大与 Genedata 的合作，统一抗体研发数据与工作流

groups.summary_en: Abcam announced an expanded Genedata collaboration on September 3, deploying Genedata Biologics across its global R&D organization. The system connects sample histories, antibody characterization and workflows across its UK headquarters and key sites in China and the US, supporting automation and AI. This is an R&D infrastructure update, not an antibody product launch. The announcement provides no independently verified percentage improvement in speed or cost.

groups.title_zh: FUJIFILM Wako：用于小鼠组织染色的抗催产素重组兔单抗 4F1
groups.summary: Wako 产品页介绍抗催产素重组兔单克隆抗体 4F1，以合成催产素肽为抗原，列出的反应种属为小鼠，适用于冷冻组织切片免疫染色。它是用于识别催产素的研究用抗体，不是催产素药物。页面也列有其他宿主来源的多克隆抗体，规格不能混用；当前只能确认产品页内容，不能据抓取日期认定首次上市时间。
groups.summary_en: Wako's page describes the recombinant rabbit monoclonal anti-oxytocin antibody 4F1, raised against a synthetic oxytocin peptide and listed for mouse frozen-section immunohistochemistry. It is a research antibody that detects oxytocin, not an oxytocin medicine. Other polyclonal antibodies on the page have different specifications. The page supports product characteristics, but the collection date does not establish the initial launch date.

groups.title_zh: FUJIFILM Wako：用于神经活动研究的豚鼠抗 c-Fos 多克隆抗体
groups.summary: Wako 介绍豚鼠来源的抗 c-Fos 多克隆抗体，列出的用途为小鼠冷冻组织切片免疫染色。c-Fos 常作为神经活动研究标志，采用豚鼠宿主可方便与兔或小鼠来源抗体进行多重染色。页面展示的是特定小鼠实验条件下的染色数据，不等于对所有物种、样本或临床诊断用途均完成验证；产品首次上市时间未确认。
groups.summary_en: Wako describes a guinea-pig polyclonal anti-c-Fos antibody for mouse frozen-section immunohistochemistry. c-Fos is used as a neuronal activity marker, and the guinea-pig host can facilitate multiplex staining with rabbit or mouse antibodies. The examples document specific mouse experiments, not validation across all species, samples or clinical diagnostic applications. The initial product launch date is not established by this page.

groups.scope_en: Official product page reviewed; research use is not presented as clinical validation.

groups.title_zh: 第一三共抗 CD25 ADC DS1025 完成 I 期试验首例给药
groups.summary: 第一三共8月28日宣布，新型抗 CD25 ADC DS1025 在晚期或转移性实体瘤患者中完成 I 期试验首例给药。该候选药物旨在作用于肿瘤微环境中的调节性 T 细胞。剂量递增研究计划在包括日本的亚洲及欧洲招募最多45人，重点评估安全性、耐受性并探索疗效。首例给药代表进入早期临床验证，不代表安全性和疗效已经确立。
groups.summary_en: Daiichi Sankyo announced first-patient dosing in a phase 1 study of the anti-CD25 ADC DS1025 on August 28. The candidate is designed to target regulatory T cells in the tumor microenvironment. The dose-escalation study plans up to 45 patients with advanced or metastatic solid tumors across Asia, including Japan, and Europe, assessing safety, tolerability and preliminary activity. First dosing is an early development milestone, not established efficacy or safety.
groups.scope_zh: 已阅读全文：第一三共官方日文公告 PDF。
groups.scope_en: Daiichi Sankyo's Japanese announcement PDF reviewed.

groups.title_zh: Dato-DXd 启动尿路上皮癌术后辅助治疗 III 期试验
groups.summary: 第一三共8月27日公布 TROPION-Urothelial04 研究首例给药。该全球 III 期试验评估抗 TROP2 ADC Dato-DXd 单药或联合 PD-1/TIGIT 双特异性抗体 rilvegostomig，用于接受术前治疗和手术后、复发风险较高的肌层浸润性尿路上皮癌患者。研究计划约915人，以无病生存期为主要终点。消息是试验启动，不是已证明优于标准治疗的结果。
groups.summary_en: Daiichi Sankyo announced first dosing in TROPION-Urothelial04 on August 27. The global phase 3 trial evaluates the anti-TROP2 ADC Dato-DXd alone or with the PD-1/TIGIT bispecific rilvegostomig as adjuvant treatment for high-risk muscle-invasive urothelial cancer after neoadjuvant therapy and surgery. Around 915 participants are planned, with disease-free survival as the primary endpoint. This is trial initiation, not a positive comparative efficacy result.
groups.scope_zh: 已核对官方公告中的方案、人数与主要终点。
groups.scope_en: Regimens, planned enrollment and primary endpoint checked in the official announcement.

groups.title_zh: Enhertu 联合帕妥珠单抗在欧盟获批用于 HER2 阳性乳腺癌一线治疗
groups.summary: 第一三共9月1日宣布，欧盟批准 Enhertu 联合帕妥珠单抗，用于不可切除或转移性 HER2 阳性乳腺癌的一线治疗，依据为 DESTINY-Breast09 III 期试验。公司将因此从阿斯利康获得1亿美元开发里程碑付款。这里同时包含特定地区的适应证扩展和合作付款节点，不应解读为所有乳腺癌人群或全球市场均获批。
groups.summary_en: Daiichi Sankyo announced EU approval of Enhertu plus pertuzumab for first-line treatment of unresectable or metastatic HER2-positive breast cancer on September 1, based on DESTINY-Breast09. Daiichi will receive a $100 million development milestone payment from AstraZeneca. The update combines a region-specific indication expansion with a partnership payment milestone; it does not establish approval for all breast cancer populations or all countries.

groups.title_zh: LEQEMBI 皮下注射起始治疗方案在中国获批，用于早期阿尔茨海默病
groups.summary: 卫材与渤健9月3日公告，中国 NMPA 批准 LEQEMBI 皮下自动注射制剂作为早期阿尔茨海默病的起始治疗，用于轻度认知障碍或轻度痴呆阶段。每周皮下注射是现有药物的新给药方式，计划在截至2027年3月的2026财年于中国上市。获批不等于已经上市；治疗仍有相关监测要求，不能将自动注射理解为无需医疗管理。
groups.summary_en: Eisai and Biogen announced Chinese approval of the LEQEMBI subcutaneous autoinjector for initiation treatment of early Alzheimer's disease on September 3, covering mild cognitive impairment or mild dementia stages. Weekly subcutaneous dosing is a new formulation of the existing medicine. A Chinese launch is planned during fiscal 2026, ending March 2027. Approval is not proof of commercial availability, and the autoinjector does not remove treatment monitoring requirements.

groups.scope_en: Joint Eisai and Biogen official announcement reviewed.

groups.summary_en: Thermo Fisher's August 31 blog recaps a company-supported ASGCT 2026 panel.
